old_problem: No environment variable was identified despite the Item title, and operator, service and container contexts could resolve different libraries/devices; source order and diagnostic-level evidence also conflicted.
disposition_reason: NVIDIA defines debugger, injection, core-dump, wait-on-exception and legacy profiling variables as software-check hazards with `DCGM_FR_BAD_CUDA_ENV`. Project-required variables and precedence can be runtime bindings with values redacted.

test_case.test_name: DCGM level-4 environment-variable context and contamination check
test_case.purpose: Verify the operator, DCGM service and optional container environments select the approved libraries/GPU visibility, contain no documented bad CUDA variables, leak no secrets, and support the complete level-4 run.
required_package: Approved CUDA/DCGM paths and GPU visibility
Approved runtime states and diagnostic safety limits
test_case.test_command: Capture only allowlisted redacted variable presence and provenance for each process context; establish the approved service environment, change persistence only with approval, run one full untruncated level-4 diagnostic, record the Environment Variables software check and all tests/skips, then verify no context drift or secret disclosure.
test_case.expected_result: All required variables originate from approved sources, documented bad CUDA variables are absent, library paths/GPU visibility match the signed contract, Environment Variables reports PASS without `DCGM_FR_BAD_CUDA_ENV`, and all expected tests pass.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the redacted multi-context matrix, named software-check result and full suite accounting; a generic command in one shell cannot validate this case.
safety_gate: Never capture secret values or embed credentials
Do not globally export or remove variables outside the approved scoped launch
Preserve complete output; stop on secret exposure, path/visibility drift or safety fault; no retry
expected_evidence: Effective library paths and GPU visibility by context
Environment check code and all skips
No-secret/no-drift postcheck and restored runtime state
test_case.recovery: Terminate the scoped run on contamination or leakage, remove only test-scoped environment changes, restore recorded service/persistence state, rotate any exposed secret through its owner, and do not rerun automatically.
